page: Microsoft Azure E2s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisors. It features 2 virtual CPUs powered by a single physical Intel Xeon 8573C processor core operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz with hyperthreading. The server is provisioned with 16.0 GB of RAM, providing a allocation of 8.0 GB of memory per vCPU. Hardware cache specifications include 48 KB of L1d, 2 MB of L2, and 260 MB of L3 cache. It supports advanced vector and matrix instructions, including AVX-512, Intel AMX tile, and AMX int8 extensions. The instance includes no local disk storage or dedicated GPU devices, and is assigned zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate high single-core execution speed alongside multi-threaded throughput limitations. The instance achieves a single-core Geekbench score of 2149.0 and a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 31.03 GB/sec. Small model LLM text generation reaches 91.22 tokens/sec. However, because the instance relies on two threads across a single physical core, multi-threaded workloads encounter processing bottlenecks. The multi-core stress-ng performance and Geekbench multi-core score fall into lower benchmark tiers. Potentially uncached memory bandwidth is recorded at 21.51 GB/sec for large block reads and 14.04 GB/sec for large block writes.

Resource allocation for the E2s_v6 delivers cost efficiency for memory-heavy tasks that do not demand extensive parallel compute resources. The absence of local ephemeral storage requires reliance on network-attached storage options such as Azure Premium Storage. This instance configuration fits light database operations, small in-memory caching systems, single-threaded text processing tasks, and lower-concurrency enterprise applications requiring elevated RAM-to-vCPU ratios.
description: Microsoft Azure E2s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Configured with 2 vCPUs across 1 physical core, it offers 16.0 GB of RAM, resulting in an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, backed by 260 MB of L3 cache and hardware support for AVX-512 and AMX instructions. The instance contains no integrated local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying on remote storage options. In performance evaluations, the instance demonstrates high single-core benchmark metrics, including strong single-thread Geekbench performance and solid single-thread compression speeds. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput and uncached memory bandwidth show performance constraints standard for single-core execution models. The E2s_v6 offers efficient resource density for low-concurrency, memory-heavy workloads such as lightweight in-memory databases, single-threaded data transformation tasks, and basic background caching services.
